info.title: Nova Trade API
info.description: REST + WebSocket API for Nova Trade.

get.summary: Stream every audit_logs row matching the given filters as CSV.
List bans.

post.summary: Create a ban (account/ip/device/hwid), with an optional expiry.
Lift a ban.

get.summary: List every coupon.

post.summary: Create a coupon (percent/fixed/free_days/lifetime).

patch.summary: Update a coupon (activate/deactivate, extend, change max redemptions).

get.summary: List abuse/fraud flags, optionally filtered.

post.summary: Mark a flag reviewed or dismissed.

get.summary: List every plan, including inactive/archived ones.

post.summary: Create a plan (including a one-off lifetime plan).
Archive a plan (is_active = false). Never a hard delete.

get.summary: List subscriptions (cursor-paginated), filterable by status/plan/userId/search (owner email).
A user's current (live) subscription plus their full subscription history.

post.summary: Manually activate a subscription for a user (plan + period).
Grant lifetime access on a plan.
Extend a subscription by N days.
Suspend a subscription.
Unsuspend a subscription, reverting to its pre-suspend status.
Cancel a subscription (at period end, or immediately).
Override one license's device limit (does not touch its plan/subscription).
Create a user account (role `user`) with a password the admin sets.
Preview whether a coupon code is valid for a plan.

get.summary: Whether the extension can be downloaded, and which version.
Download the Nova Trade extension (zip). Requires an active pass.
The signed-in user's Tampermonkey install link. The script behind it is served only while their pass is active.
The Nova Trade userscript for Tampermonkey (signed per-user link). Requires an active pass.
The userscript's header, which Tampermonkey polls for updates (signed per-user link). Requires an active pass.
Current user's license: key prefix + status only, never the full key.

post.summary: Revoke the current license and issue a new one. Returns the full key exactly once.
Validate a license key for a device: status, entitlements, signed blob.
Submit the PayPal transaction ID for a pass you paid for.

get.summary: Your submitted payments, newest first.
Submitted PayPal payments to review, newest first.

post.summary: Approve a PayPal payment: issues or extends the pass.
Reject a PayPal payment claim, with a reason the buyer sees.

get.summary: Current user's payment history, cursor-paginated.
List active plans with prices, features and device limits.
One user's safety-governor event history.
Current subscription + license + devices + resolved entitlements.

post.summary: Start a 7-day trial, once per account. Denied with TRIAL_ALREADY_USED after a past trial, TRIAL_ABUSE_DETECTED on abuse signals.
Cancel at period end (stays active until current_period_end).
Undo a pending cancel-at-period-end, while still before the period end.

get.summary: Stream the caller's trades matching the given filters as CSV.

post.summary: Issue a single-use WebSocket auth ticket (30s TTL).
